name: Recipe Cost Calculator & Menu Pricing Agent

values.content:
You are a practical food cost consultant with experience in restaurants, catering, and food businesses. You analyze recipe cost breakdowns and give specific, actionable pricing advice.

You understand food cost percentages, menu psychology, and where chefs can trim costs without sacrificing quality. You're direct — if a dish is too expensive to price competitively, you say so.

Keep your note under 200 words. Write in plain English, not consultant-speak.

parameters.jsCode:
const advice = $input.first().json.text || $input.first().json.content?.[0]?.text || ''; const d = $('Calculate Costs').first().json; const input = d.input; function esc(s) { return String(s||'').replace(/&/g,'&').replace(//g,'>'); } const cur = input.currency; const ingRows = d.costedIngredients.map(i => { const barWidth = Math.round(i.pctOfTotal / 5); const bar = '█'.repeat(barWidth) + '░'.repeat(20 - barWidth); return ` ${esc(i.name)} ${i.quantity} ${esc(i.unit)} ${cur}${i.unitCost.toFixed(4)} ${cur}${i.lineCost.toFixed(2)} ${i.pctOfTotal}% `; }).join(''); const priceRows = [ { label: `At ${d.pricing.targetFoodCostPct}% food cost`, price: d.pricing.atTargetFoodCostPct, highlight: true }, { label: 'At 3× markup', price: d.pricing.at3x, highlight: false }, { label: 'At 3.5× markup', price: d.pricing.at35x, highlight: false }, { label: 'At 4× markup', price: d.pricing.at4x, highlight: false } ].map(r => `
${esc(r.label)} ${cur}${r.price.toFixed(2)}
`).join(''); const adviceHtml = advice.replace(/\*\*(.+?)\*\*/g, '$1').replace(/\n/g, '
'); const html = `
Recipe Cost Analysis
${esc(input.recipeName)}
Serves ${input.serves} · Cost per serving: ${cur}${d.totals.costPerServingDisplay}
Ingredient Cost
${cur}${d.totals.ingredientCostBatch}
batch
Total Cost
${cur}${d.totals.overheadAdjustedCost}
w/ labor + overhead
Per Serving
${cur}${d.totals.costPerServingDisplay}
food cost
Pricing options
${priceRows}
Pricing advice

${adviceHtml}

Ingredient breakdown
${ingRows}
Ingredient Qty Unit Cost Line Cost % of total
Recipe Cost Calculator · ${new Date().toLocaleDateString()}
`; return [{ json: { html, replyEmail: input.replyEmail, recipeName: input.recipeName, costPerServing: d.totals.costPerServingDisplay, suggestedPrice: d.pricing.atTargetFoodCostPct, currency: cur, result: { totals: d.totals, pricing: d.pricing, costedIngredients: d.costedIngredients } } }];

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { status: 'calculated', recipe: $json.recipeName, cost_per_serving: $json.costPerServing, suggested_price: $json.suggestedPrice, currency: $json.currency, emailed: $json.replyEmail ? true : false, result: $json.result } }}
